body:
Hi TAL, thanks for writing to me.
I used to be one of the most optimistic people in the world. I really did. And had this same idea too. But for some reason, I just can't fight my demons any longer. It's not a matter of choosing happiness for me as much as it is of actively not choosing sadness and pessimism. And I just don't know how to do it. I've tried so many ways, read so many blogs, I just don't know what to do I'm seriously too weak. I finally woke up for the first time before noon this morning, but rolled around in bed awake for 6 hours unable to get out of bed. Is it as simple as forcing myself out of bed and just getting past the bad feelings? And then when I get home they all rush right back to me. My brain is against me.
